tools.name: render
tools.does: page.html to PNG with the local Edge or Chrome (headless, local files only); args: page, out PNG path, optional WxH size

args.name: page
args.does: path to the page.html to render

args.name: out
args.does: path of the PNG to write

tools.name: thumb
tools.does: 256px thumbnail PNG of a design from its brief.json (the size a store listing shows), written beside the brief

args.name: out
args.does: thumbnail PNG path, default beside the brief

for: factory F6: cover readable at listing size

tools.name: audit
tools.does: audits a design from its brief.json: contrast, size, title box, 256px legibility, RTL; PASS or FAIL per check, writes design-audit.json
for: factory F6: gate before a cover is adopted

tools.name: judge
tools.does: scores a design from its brief.json with rubric ds-quality-v1 (10 checks, ship at 8); writes DESIGN-REVIEW.md, prints SHIP or REWORK

args.name: brief
args.does: path to the design's brief.json (or its folder)

for: factory F6: ship or rework verdict for a cover

tools.name: tokens
tools.does: builds tokens.css (light and dark, no hardcoded colors) and a docs page from a brand tokens.json, written beside the json
for: factory: one brand palette for every cover

tools.name: block
tools.does: emits one landing block (hero works with defaults) as an HTML section on stdout; all colors through var(--*)

args.name: block
args.does: block id from templates/registry.json, for example hero

args.name: slot1
args.does: a SLOT=value pair, for example TITLE=Hello

for: factory F6: free magnet and listing pages

tools.name: orders
tools.does: checks the order book (every customer, every kind) and writes the lane desk: one row per seat

args.name: desk
args.does: write sprint/queue/desk.md from orders.csv and designs/<id>/ folders, print the DESK line

args.name: covers
args.does: D5: live factory listings against adopted cover rows

for: every lane seat: wake on your BLD/DLV/EYE row, oldest order first
lead: one DESK line per round, no clock inside a row
tools.first_job: wrote sprint/queue/desk.md from today's orders.csv with node tools/orders-check.mjs --desk
